artworks.label: 3 Nephi 17:21–25
artworks.title: Angels minister to the children
artworks.caption: After blessing the children one by one, Jesus asks the multitude to behold their little ones. The heavens open, angels descend, and fire encircles the children as the angels minister to them. The people witness this together and preserve their testimony of what they have seen and heard.
artworks.alt: Angels in white minister around children encircled by heavenly fire while Christ and their families attend to them.

review.reason: Actual pixels retain natural angel hands on children shoulders, teenage male resting hand on knee, older male interacting with child, varied male/female age appearances. Christ remains recognizably consistent with approved face, gentle warm expression and gaze toward central girl. Full rising heavenly flames encircle children; clothing and skin show no burning, injury or distress. Perspective overlap is not a defect under clarified owner preference. Prior low-ring/bare-ground-clearance hold superseded by explicit owner direction. Owner approval metadata handled separately under standing instruction.

Fits intended age 21 visually; no claim that exact age is measurable. Mutual gaze, plate-handoff grips and liked composition retained.
